budget.metric: relative error of the simulated temperature rise above ambient at the measured location (IR window average, or contact-area average for a tool-work thermocouple)
budget.note: IR measurements carry +-8 % (Slusarczyk 2025) and NIST IR microscopy +-52 C at 2 sigma on peaks of several hundred C (Burns 2012), so a reference rise is known to about 8-10 %. Calibrated thermal models reach 3-4 % against a tool-work thermocouple (Loeschner 2025) and 17 % against IR (Slusarczyk 2025), while FE with literature constitutive data has missed the peak interface temperature by hundreds of C (Burns 2012). 15 % of the rise is a demanding but reachable bound.
